title: Chapter 113 Let'S Go Home
content:
Chapter 113 Let'S Go Home

Soon, Lu Daosheng brought Yan Lingyun to the Yuanji Taoist Temple.

The magnificent palace stands quietly like a giant standing tall.

Just standing in front of him can clearly feel the supreme aura coming from him.

"Spiritual rhyme?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng turned his head to look at Yan Lingyun.

Yan Lingyun looked up at the Yuanji Temple at this time, and her eyes became a little lost.

With a wave of his hand, Yan Lingyun immediately returned to normal.

"I,,"

Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled slightly.

"Let's go in."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun nodded, "Okay."

Immediately, the two of them slowly walked into the Source Dojo hand in hand.

In the magnificent hall, five huge balls of light filled with the aura of special rules are suspended here.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun said solemnly: "The origin of the law!"

Buzz —

At this time, a strange aura suddenly surged out of the hall.

The next moment, a majestic voice sounded.

"Who dares to trek into my own temple?"

Venerable Yuanji!

Yan Lingyun immediately said, "Senior, I,"

However, Lu Daosheng on the side did not give Yan Lingyun a chance at all, and directly reached out to block Yan Lingyun's little mouth.

"Hmm."

Lu Daosheng smiled, and then a breath slowly overflowed from his body.

"Don't you come out to meet us?"

Lu Daosheng said with a faint smile.

The hall was silent for a moment.

Suddenly, an illusory figure slowly emerged and gradually condensed.

I saw that it was an old man wearing a star patterned robe, his eyes were full of vicissitudes, as if he had just experienced a reboot of the universe.

Is this the Lord of Yuanji?

When Yan Lingyun saw the real person, she was obviously a little excited and wanted to say something, but her mouth was blocked by Lu Daosheng, which made Yan Lingyun a little angry.

It’s a pity that she can’t beat Lu Daosheng now, so she can only stare at Lu Daosheng with a small resentful look like a woman.

"Who are you?"

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Venerable Yuanji frowned slightly.

This is the first time he has seen an existence that can be comparable to himself here.

Hearing the words of the Master Yuanji, Lu Daosheng slowly let go of Yan Lingyun, and then smiled and said, "My wife admires you a little because it was you who created the order of this world."

Upon hearing this, Venerable Yuanji's expression slightly relaxed.

These words are inexplicably comfortable.

Logically speaking, there are almost countless people who praise me, and I should have been immune.

But this was said from Lu Daosheng.

This is an existence at the same level as one.

This kind of praise is naturally a little more advanced.

Just when Master Yuanji was feeling a little proud, Lu Daosheng suddenly said, "But, I think there should be only one person my wife should worship, that is me."

As soon as these words came out, the corner of the slightly raised mouth of Venerable Yuanji fell.

On the side, Yan Lingyun's face turned slightly red for some reason.

"Daosheng, what are you going to do?"

Lu Daosheng reached out and touched Yan Lingyun's head, and smiled and said, "As my wife, you don't need to worship anyone in this world. If you have to, then that person can only be me."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at the Master Yuanji in front of him.

"Your Excellency, please ask me."

Hearing this, Venerable Yuanji narrowed his eyes slightly.

"Are you sure?"

Lu Daosheng nodded, "Confirm."

On the side, Yan Lingyun remained silent. In a short period of time, too many things happened that made her unable to digest it.

Buzz —

At this time, Master Yuanji waved his hand.

The surrounding scenes changed instantly, and the three of them were directly in a sea of stars.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

Not to mention, I actually just want to abuse you, it’s the same everywhere.

It’s a pity that Venerable Yuanji didn’t know what Lu Daosheng was thinking. When he saw Lu Daosheng shook his head, he thought the other party was despising him, which made him a little angry.

He has been high for too long for the endless years.

Obviously, I am not used to Lu Daosheng's somewhat casual attitude.

But he would not be careless, just the slightest breath that Lu Daosheng showed made him understand that the other party would definitely not be weaker than him.

So, this time he will definitely do his best.

"Let's take action."

Master Yuanji said in a deep voice.

At this time, Yan Lingyun had been sent by Lu Daosheng to a safe place to watch the battle.

Hearing the words of Master Yuanji, Lu Daosheng nodded, "Okay."

If you say so, I'm not polite.

As a warded man, how could he fight with Master Yuanji in the same realm?

Now, under the influence of the system, his cultivation has surpassed the Yuanji Venerable.

However, in order to make it more interesting, Lu Daosheng finally chose to fight hand-to-hand.

Bang!

Lu Daosheng instantly flashed in front of the Master Yuanji, and a heavy punch hit the Master Yuanji's face.

Of course, Lu Daosheng naturally had to stop his strength, otherwise with his current strength and punch with all his strength, he would probably not even be able to find the scum.

"Ah! What,"

A scream rang out, and before the Master Yuanji could react, another attack came.

Bang bang bang!

Suddenly, the starry sky continued to break, and the scene was directly one-sided.

In the distance, Yan Lingyun was irritated when she saw the person she once admired was hanging and beaten by her man.

Sure enough, there are always people who are better than you, and even a figure like Yuan Ji Zun Zun is not invincible.

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Yan Lingyun was full of thoughts.

"Stop, stop, stop! Stop hitting me!"

"I admit defeat!"

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng stopped.

"Old man, can you do it?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Yuan Ji Zun Zun, who was already bruised and swollen, and laughed.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Yuan Ji Zun was silent.

Where the hell did this monster come from?

He didn't even have the strength to fight back.

"Well, senior, please don't tease me. I don't bully people like this."

He was so much stronger than me, but he still asked for advice.

You can just say you want to beat me up.

Seeing Yuan Ji Zun like this, Lu Daosheng shook his head in boredom, and then came to Yan Lingyun's side.

"Lingyun,"

"Stop talking."

As soon as Lu Daosheng opened his mouth, Yan Lingyun interrupted him.

"You are invincible, I believe it, okay."

Yan Lingyun's eyes were slightly red, and she said with some grievance.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng went straight forward and hugged Yan Lingyun in his arms.

"Let's go home, okay?"

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun burst into tears.

"Okay."

At this moment, the pressure that had accumulated for a long time suddenly disappeared.

In this way, Lu Daosheng took Yan Lingyun away from here and embarked on the road back to Xuanling Star Domain.

And Lu Daosheng's cultivation aura began to gradually decrease.

These are just temporary blessings from the system.

Of course, as long as Lu Daosheng wants, he can rise at any time.

"Oh, by the way, I almost forgot one thing."

Muxian Realm.

On this day, a giant hand covering the sky fell from the sky with a world-destroying aura.

The terrifying aura emanating from it made all the practitioners in the entire Wood Immortal Realm feel despair.

"Doomsday, doomsday is coming."

"What on earth is this?!"

"Is it possible that the heavens are going to destroy my entire Wood Immortal Realm?"

Countless practitioners looked at the giant hand above the sky with despair.

It was not until the giant hand fell that the world finally reacted.

Boom!

A terrifying explosion sounded.

A great power that had been passed down for endless years disappeared from the Wood Immortal Realm.

At the same time, in a corner of the Wood Immortal Realm, a woman in plain clothes looked at this scene with a pale face and slowly collapsed to the ground.

"The Immortal Holy Land is gone."
